verdict: Yes, it is safe to merge once the low-severity points are fixed or accepted. Every count in the post matches the public write-up and the sealed stores, the scoping follows the write-up, and nothing private is in it. Two statements rest only on things outside main (the quote from a commenter and the location of the retry demo), and the post is wrapped at 100 columns where the first post uses 92.

The paraphrase in the post ("proposed writing the next step into the error text") is also slightly stronger than the write-up's "asked whether a message that names the next step ... would close the gap".
findings.fix: Keep the quote only if it is word for word from the public Hashnode comment, and the maintainer should check that. Otherwise paraphrase it as the write-up does.

findings.problem: The post says "A scripted test with no model, in the repository, shows how such a retry behaves." That test (plan/exec/v2/study/order-desk-empty-message/tests/code_retry_demo.py) exists only at working-records commit 49d86b3, which is on origin/v2/phase0. verdict: Yes, safe to merge. The new test passes and really holds the post's main result counts to the run 3 and run 2 stores, the pinned hashes all match, and nothing else in the repo needs to change by existing practice. A few secondary numbers in the post are not held by any test (low).

findings.problem: Some store-derived numbers in the post are not held. Line 21 quotes "34 of the 4B's 52 failures", and the test only asserts the substring "of the 4B's 52 failures", so a wrong 34 would pass. Erratum 2 at lines 110-111 says the records give 33 of 34 (32 is the registration's figure), and no test re-derives that either. The write-up quotes the same 34 and 33 (order-desk-study.md:120, :255-256) and its tests do not hold them, so this does not break precedent. The post is still quoting record-derived figures as checked when they are not.
findings.fix: Either derive the two figures from the run 2 trials (candidate failures whose injected fault is the empty lookup, then the subset on the 8 run 3 task ids) and assert "34 of the 4B's 52 failures" and "The records give 33 of 34", or say in the test docstring that these two figures are checked only by hand.

findings.problem: Structural numbers in the post are not asserted against the manifest: 8 cases or tasks (len(decision.cells)), the margin of 10 percentage points, and "the other 16 tasks". The 6 of 8 and 3 of 8 smoke counts (line 52-53) come from no committed store, so they cannot be held. These do not belong to the result section, which is fully held.
findings.fix: Optional: assert len(decision.cells) == 8 next to "on 8 selected cases" or "over the 8 tasks", and assert the rule's margin in the "more than 10 percentage points" sentence. Leave the smoke counts unasserted, since they are not in the repository.
